status: first pass (roadmap R6, docs/scenery/README.md "The map's dressing")
notes: How the map's woods are planted and its open ground is coloured (simcore/scenery/map_dressing.hpp, read by LoadDressingRules): presentation only, nothing in the simulation reads it (the sight lines read the map's obstacle heights, which no tree here ever stands above). Trees stand only in the map proper and the detail areas: a wood's block inside a detail area is planted whole, elsewhere in the map proper its open sides get rows of trees and its inside is a mass; the far ground's woods are masses only. Colours are linear RGB.
source: game value: sam3d estimate (the look of the Pannonian plain's woods, shelter belts and fields, to be tuned against -SimMapShots)
